objective: maximize net capital generated with increasing autonomy

portfolioDiversity.exception: a domain may exceed the share only when superior economic performance is demonstrated with external evidence

killIf: negative expected economics after evidence update
material legal, security, or operational risk
promoteIf: evidence of repeat purchase or reproducible acquisition channel

learningLoopPolicy.buyerBlockedState: When an experiment has enough public evidence, a usable artifact and a defined buyer gate, mark it buyer-blocked until new external buyer evidence exists.
learningLoopPolicy.noResearchSubstitution: Do not keep adding competitor, pricing or market-research notes merely to simulate progress while the next falsifiable step requires buyer contact or buyer data.
learningLoopPolicy.rotationRule: A buyer-blocked experiment keeps its incubation slot but autonomous cycles rotate to other active experiments or open-world discovery unless genuinely decision-changing evidence appears.
learningLoopPolicy.widenBeforeKill: Competition or a narrow wedge is not itself a kill signal. Test adjacent value capture or a wider job-to-be-done when evidence supports it.

payments.connectStripeWhen: a qualified buyer is ready to pay and payment friction becomes the bottleneck

railwayBudget.reason: Railway workspace billing limits are not writable through the connected Railway tools; must be set in Workspace Usage/Billing
